project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is stated as Madsen Gold, and the article confirms the acquisition of the 'Madsen Gold Project'. 'West Red Lake Gold Mines Completes Acquisition of Madsen Gold Project...'

company_name.value: West Red Lake Gold Mines Ltd.
company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the headline and opening sentence: 'West Red Lake Gold Mines Ltd. (“West Red Lake Gold” or the “Company”) (TSXV: WRLG) (OTCQB: WRLGF) is pleased to announce that it has completed the acquisition (the “Acquisition”) of the Madsen Gold Project...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The most recent article, dated June 19, 2023, which announces the completion of the acquisition, identifies the CEO: '“The Company’s acquisition of the Madsen Gold Project...”, said Shane Williams, President and CEO of West Red Lake Gold Mines.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company acquired all shares of the target company, which owns the project: '...completed the acquisition (the “Acquisition”) of the Madsen Gold Project through the acquisition of all of the outstanding shares of Pure Gold Mining Inc. (“PGM”).'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as a gold project. 'The Company’s acquisition of the Madsen Gold Project includes a fully permitted underground gold mine...'

verified_article_link.justification: No verifiable URL was provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The cash payment is listed with a '$' symbol while a separate deferred payment is explicitly listed in 'US$'. The buyer is listed on the Canadian TSXV exchange and a previous market cap was mentioned in 'C$1 billion', implying the primary currency is CAD.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is an aggregate of the main payment and the finders fees: 'the Company paid $6.5 million in cash' and 'paid finders fees of $325,000 in cash'. A further US$6,783,932 in deferred consideration is also mentioned.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction involved the issuance of shares, but no explicit dollar value for this share component was provided in the text.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The text provides separate components for cash and shares, not a single combined value for the transaction.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: This is the sum of shares issued to Sprott (32,566,174), further shares to be issued (8,164,503), and finder's shares (2,036,534). 'Pursuant to the Acquisition, the Company issued 32,566,174 common shares... A further 8,164,503 common shares will be issued... In connection with the Acquisition the Company... issued 2,036,534 common shares.'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text mentions that '3,750,000 warrants were issued', but does not assign a raw monetary value to them.

option_payments_raw.justification: No option payments were mentioned in the transaction details.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.85'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters was mentioned in the text.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No monetary exploration commitment was mentioned in the text.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, the buyer granted a royalty to a third party financier: 'has granted a 1% secured net smelter royalty on the Madsen Mine to Sprott.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states the project includes 'the associated 47 Km2 highly prospective land package in the Red Lake district of Ontario.'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states the project includes 'the associated 47 Km2 highly prospective land package in the Red Lake district of Ontario.'

resource_size.value: 1,653,000 Gold Troy Ounces (Indicated) and 366,200 Gold Troy Ounces (Inferred)
resource_size.justification: The resource is detailed in a table in the text: 'Total Indicated| 6,909,900| 7.4| 1,653,000' and 'Total Inferred| 1,819,300| 6.3| 366,200'. The values are for Gold Troy Ounces.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first paragraph: 'West Red Lake Gold Mines Ltd. (“West Red Lake Gold” or the “Company”) (TSXV: WRLG)'.
